summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP), released by Anthropic in November 2024, has become the standard interface connecting AI agents and coding assistants to external tools, data, and APIs — reaching roughly 97 million monthly SDK downloads by December 2025 and gaining governance under the Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation. MCP transforms capable but isolated AI models into agents that can browse the web, control browsers, query databases, manage repos, and automate real workflows. The ecosystem now spans individual servers, multi-app aggregators, and enterprise gateways.
ecosystem_note: Individual MCP servers expose one tool or service (e.g. GitHub, Playwright) to an agent, aggregators bundle hundreds or thousands of integrations behind a single endpoint, and gateways/proxies sit in front of MCP traffic to add auth, routing, observability, and governance for enterprise deployments.

tools.name: GitHub MCP Server
tools.connects_to: GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, Actions, code search, and file operations
tools.pricing_paid: Free; usage governed by existing GitHub plan limits (Free/Team/Enterprise)
strengths: Official first-party server with broad coverage of the GitHub API
Deep integration with Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code and other agents
Massive install base across developer tooling
tools.best_for: AI-driven code review, repo automation, and issue/PR management

tools.name: Playwright MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Browser automation — navigation, clicks, form fills, scraping, and E2E testing via accessibility tree
strengths: Deterministic, accessibility-tree-based browser control (no screenshots required)
Backed by Microsoft and the mature Playwright project
Extremely popular for agentic web tasks and testing
tools.best_for: Agents that need to browse, test, and interact with real web UIs

tools.name: Composio MCP
tools.connects_to: 1,500+ apps (Gmail, Slack, Notion, Linear, Jira, GitHub, etc.) through one managed endpoint with built-in auth
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier available; paid plans scale by active connections/usage (team and enterprise tiers)
strengths: Consolidates many integrations behind a single server and auth layer
Managed OAuth and token refresh removes maintenance overhead
Strong adoption among Cursor and agent builders
tools.best_for: Teams wanting broad SaaS connectivity without managing dozens of servers

tools.name: Filesystem MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Local filesystem — reading, writing, searching, and editing files within permitted directories
strengths: Reference server maintained by Anthropic
Foundational capability used by nearly all coding agents
Simple, secure directory-scoped access
tools.best_for: Local file access and manipulation for coding and document agents

tools.name: Figma MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Figma design files — extracting layout, components, styles, and design context for code generation
tools.pricing_paid: Free with a Figma account; advanced Dev Mode features require paid Figma plans
strengths: Official Dev Mode MCP server bridging design and code
Enables accurate design-to-code workflows
Rapidly adopted for frontend agent tasks
tools.best_for: Translating Figma designs into production-ready UI code

tools.name: Cloudflare MCP Server / Remote MCP
tools.connects_to: Cloudflare Workers, deployment of remote MCP servers, plus AI Gateway routing and observability
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier via Workers; paid scaling through Workers Paid and AI Gateway usage
strengths: First-class support for hosting remote/authenticated MCP servers
Built-in OAuth, edge deployment, and observability
Strong enterprise and developer adoption
tools.best_for: Deploying and hosting remote MCP servers at the edge with auth

tools.name: Docker MCP Toolkit / Catalog
tools.connects_to: Containerized MCP servers from a curated catalog, with secure isolation and credential management
tools.pricing_paid: Free with Docker Desktop; Docker Business/Team subscriptions for advanced features
strengths: Run MCP servers in isolated containers for security
Curated MCP catalog and one-click setup via Docker Desktop
Centralized secrets and gateway routing
tools.best_for: Securely running and managing multiple MCP servers in containers

tools.name: Smithery
tools.connects_to: A registry/marketplace of thousands of MCP servers with hosted deployment and discovery
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier; paid hosting and usage plans for scaled deployments
strengths: Largest MCP server registry for discovery and install
Hosted deployment of community servers
Popular entry point for finding new MCP tools
tools.best_for: Discovering, installing, and hosting community MCP servers

tools.name: Fetch / Web Fetch MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Fetching and converting web page content (HTML to markdown) for agent consumption
strengths: Reference server for basic web retrieval
Lightweight and widely bundled into agent setups
Converts pages to LLM-friendly markdown
tools.best_for: Giving agents simple web-page retrieval capability

tools.name: mcp.so
tools.connects_to: A directory indexing thousands of MCP servers and clients for discovery
strengths: One of the most-visited MCP discovery directories
Comprehensive index of servers across categories
High search traffic among developers exploring MCP
tools.best_for: Browsing and finding the right MCP server for a task

tools.name: Firecrawl MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Web scraping, crawling, and structured data extraction at scale for AI agents
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier with credits; paid plans scale by crawl/scrape volume
strengths: Robust large-scale crawling and JS-rendered scraping
Clean structured/markdown output for LLMs
Strong adoption for research and data-gathering agents
tools.best_for: Deep web research and large-scale structured scraping

tools.name: PostgreSQL MCP Server
tools.connects_to: PostgreSQL databases — schema inspection and read-only (and extended) SQL queries
strengths: Reference database server widely adapted for data agents
Safe schema introspection and querying
Foundation for many database MCP forks
tools.best_for: Letting agents query and explore relational databases
